messages.subject: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for your quote and your willingness to demonstrate reliability. A dependable partnership matters to us too, and we acknowledge that our late payments have added to your cash pressure.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Our analysis supports tighter quality commitments, while keeping complaint charges out of these packages limits your exposure. We are flexible on the quality commitment and corresponding price; please choose the package your production can reliably support.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 43.78 per unit, quality commitment 300 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option B: EUR 43.55 per unit, quality commitment 800 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option C: EUR 43.24 per unit, quality commitment 1500 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.

Who can authorize binding commitments during the insolvency proceedings, and what funding, material and capacity are secured for our next 56 days of deliveries?

We value the relationship and want to support dependable recovery.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We offer a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Don't worry about the rumors, we are running normally with secured materials for your deliveries, and our management signs contracts as usual. Since you brought up the late payments, paying us on time would really help our cash situation right now. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Beside this option, we can offer an alternative with a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We can agree to the 1500 ppm target, but we need €46.00 per unit to make it work on our end.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for adjusting your price and confirming that our quality record is accurate. We understand that faster payment matters more to you than another price negotiation, and acknowledge that our late payments have added to your cash pressure.

We are making a modest price step and are flexible on complaint charges; the option without chargebacks gives you the complaint-cost protection you proposed in exchange for further price movement from you. Please choose which package works best, while retaining the tighter quality commitment.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 44.44 per unit, EUR 500 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option B: EUR 44.30 per unit, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option C: EUR 44.34 per unit, EUR 150 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.

We value our relationship and want these terms to support dependable supply, backed by measurable quality and delivery recovery.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red

Hello,

Thanks for the new options, we will go with the 0 EUR chargeback as it's safer for us. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. I can drop the price to EUR 46.00 for this setup, which is a good step towards you. So, our offer is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

You mentioned delivery recovery, could you send us the data you base this on? Also, paying our invoices on time is the most important thing for us right now. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Got your email and checked the volume and energy index numbers, so I can do €45.50 for this setup. We offer a price of €45.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We have already taken that quality record data into account. 

As to the index change and volume change data you cited, we see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. I'm dropping the price again, so please make sure your accounting pays our invoices on time, that's the most important thing for us. 

We don't send out cost breakdowns, that's strictly internal, but this price is really as good as it gets. Material accounts for about 30 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. 

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
messages.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for lowering your price again; we recognise your need to protect margin and your preference for faster payment. Our late payments have added to your cash pressure, and your request for dependable payment is fair.

We are making a modest upward price step and retaining the proposal without complaint charges, providing the complaint-cost protection you requested in exchange for further price movement from you. This proposal does not offer faster payment, and the quality commitment remains firm.

We propose: EUR 44.80 per unit, quality commitment 300 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.

We value our relationship and would welcome your confirmation that the proposed commitments can receive the necessary administrator approval.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
